evidence.timingScope: Five alternating pairs use production FluxMouseoverKeybind and modeled native write APIs. Each settled burst emits 20 roster notifications. Fresh five- and forty-cell groups exercise first discovery. Matched counts and prepared route signatures establish the affected callback work. Actual invitation and frame-time cost are outside this fixture.

parity: Stable mouse-only roster discovery now skips an action-bar binding scan. Thirty modeled bursts across each client profile go from 570 native binding reads to zero. Early registrations still sample each action binding once per scan, including keys after nil or empty results. Forty newly discovered raid cells cut binding reads from 1,179 to 600 in the Forever model and from 419 to 120 in the Era model. Mouse and wheel routes, discovery and protected write counts match.
rules: Only spell-hover routes qualify for the native unit-exists driver. When the last spell-hover route is removed under the mouse, the same out-of-combat lifecycle parks that driver. Public routing detection still recognizes ordinary mouse and wheel bindings. Full binding and Edit Mode refreshes, frame registration and combat deferral retain their existing owners.
nativeAcceptance: Current live invite, leave, raid conversion timing and combat taint remain pending. Full action-strip, border seams, minimap and combat exit acceptance remain part of the active roadmap.
